entities.summary: Arthur de Beauplan, The son of the writer and composer Amédée de Beauplan, he wrote numerous vaudevilles and libretti for opéras comiques for Adolphe Adam, Ferdinand Poise or Théodore Dubois, in collaboration in particular with Adolphe de Leuven and Léon Lévy Brunswick.
